hooks.prompt: Check one reply of an agent working on ORVION. Hook input: $ARGUMENTS. If stop_hook_active is true, answer {"ok": true}. Read last_assistant_message. If it claims no result, completion, test outcome, approval or fact taken from a tool, agent or web page, answer {"ok": true}. Otherwise answer {"ok": false, "reason": "..."} when one of these holds, the reason naming the rule and quoting the sentence to fix: DEC-33 rule 4, it acts on or claims an approval that the owner's live message or a recorded delegation does not give; DEC-33 rule 5, it states another agent's, tool's or page's claim as verified fact without saying whose claim it is; DEC-33 rule 10, it says done, passed, proven or fixed without naming how it was checked and the artifact that shows it. Else answer {"ok": true}.
